description:
List native HTTP requests from URLSession and NSURLConnection on iOS simulators, or OkHttp in a debuggable Android build. Use when debugging traffic from a native module or SDK. Coverage excludes background URLSession transfers, WKWebView and Network.framework.
Call network-capture-start before triggering requests. Returns recent requests oldest first, with capture status and coverage in header. The log stays readable after capture stops. Pass an ID to view-network-request-details.
On an iOS simulator, a blocked read returns status and a message with the next action. Follow the message before retrying.
If the call fails with NATIVE_DEVTOOLS_NOT_CONNECTED, follow its message.
An Apple system app is rejected outright (terminal: never retry it).

bundleId.description: App bundle ID on iOS or package name on Android.

clear.description: Hide existing history from later lists. Cleared request IDs still work in view-network-request-details. Default: false.

limit.description: Take the newest matching requests and return them oldest first. Use 0 for capture status and totals without entries. Default: 50. Minimum: 0.

port.description: Exclude requests to this Metro port on local addresses. Omit it to use the device's Metro port (usually 8081). Range: 1 to 65535.

udid.description: Device ID from list-devices: an iOS simulator UDID or Android serial

name: native-network-logs
